description: Use when the user asks whether rules are coming on a topic, or how much federal rule-making mentions it, optionally for one agency. Returns, year by year, the share of U.S. federal final and proposed rules that mention the phrase, from the Federal Register, against every final and proposed rule that year, with a null control that must read 0. Every result carries a run id, a date and a citation line. Calling this tool returns a quote, not the result: what the run measures, its price and a payment_url. The run happens only when you POST to payment_url, and a run that fails its controls refuses there with nothing charged. For deadlines and comment windows, use run_regulatory_clock. Dimensions (vary these inputs to cut the answer; each call is its own run): over time: built in: share by year; segment: agency narrows to one regulator. Price: $0.05 per run over x402 (USDC on Base, no account needed), or $0.50 over MPP (a Stripe shared payment token); charged only when the run comes back sound. A real sample of this run, free: https://cultmath.com/agent/samples/regulatory-trend.json

agency.description: Optional: count only this agency's rules.

end.description: Last year, not in the future. Default: this year. At most 10 years per run.

phrase.description: The phrase to count, without quote marks, e.g. "front-of-package" or "PFAS".

start.description: First year (1994 onward). Default: four years ago.
